name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 10 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 37 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-08-25, at wavelengths from 1.00 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
